text: As Farquhar fell straight down. <break time="0.8s" /> Between the timbers of the bridge. <break time="0.8s" /> He lost consciousness. <break time="0.8s" /> And seemed to be already dead. <break time="0.8s" /> He was awakened. <break time="0.8s" /> By a sharp pain in his throat. <break time="0.8s" /> And then he felt. <break time="0.8s" /> As if he could not breathe at all. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the rope broke. <break time="0.8s" /> And he fell into the stream. <break time="0.8s" /> With a loud splash. <break time="0.8s" /> The cold water closing over his head. <break time="0.8s" /> Deep under the water. <break time="0.8s" /> He fought to free his hands. <break time="0.8s" /> And at last the cord around his wrists. <break time="0.8s" /> Gave way. <break time="0.8s" /> He tore the rope from his neck. <break time="0.8s" /> And rose to the surface. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he took a deep breath. <break time="0.8s" /> Of the sweet air. <break time="0.8s" /> Never before had his senses been so sharp. <break time="0.8s" /> For he could see every leaf. <break time="0.8s" /> On the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> And even the tiny insects on them. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking back. <break time="0.8s" /> He saw the bridge, the fort, and the soldiers. <break time="0.8s" /> Who were pointing at him and shouting. <break time="0.8s" /> The captain gave orders. <break time="0.8s" /> In a calm, slow voice. <break time="0.8s" /> And the guards began to fire their rifles. <break time="0.8s" /> At the man in the water. <break time="0.8s" /> Bullets struck the water. <break time="0.8s" /> All around him. <break time="0.8s" /> So he dived as deep as he could and swam hard with the current.
